import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

files=['pbmc3k.h5ad','10x_pbmc68k_reduced.h5ad']
adata=[]
for f in files:
    a=ad.read_h5ad(f)
    print(f, 'shape', a.shape, 'var_names dtype', a.var_names.dtype, 'unique', len(a.var_names.unique()))
    if 'gene_symbols' in a.var.columns:
        print(' gene_symbols missing', a.var['gene_symbols'].isna().sum(), 'nunique', a.var['gene_symbols'].nunique())
        # filter missing gene_symbols per instruction? Need decide subset
    adata.append(a)

# common genes intersection of var_names exact string values
common = sorted(set(adata[0].var_names.astype(str)) & set(adata[1].var_names.astype(str)))
print('common count', len(common))
# subset in order? use index intersection preserving order perhaps
for i,a in enumerate(adata):
    mask=a.var_names.isin(common)
    print('before filter', i, a.shape)
    # exclude missing gene_symbols if column exists; only var-level filter beyond this
    if 'gene_symbols' in a.var.columns:
        # keep rows not missing gene_symbols (but no further)
        mask = mask & a.var['gene_symbols'].notna()
    a = a[:, mask].copy()
    print('after subset/filter', i, a.shape)
    # common may need intersection after filter? We'll check
    adata[i]=a

# Recompute common after filtering maybe intersection
common2=sorted(set(adata[0].var_names.astype(str)) & set(adata[1].var_names.astype(str)))
print('common after filter', len(common2))
for i,a in enumerate(adata):
    m=a.var_names.isin(common2)
    a=a[:,m].copy()
    print('final',i,a.shape)
    adata[i]=a

for i,a in enumerate(adata):
    print('running HVG',i, a.shape, 'X dtype',a.X.dtype, 'X sparse', hasattr(a.X,'toarray'))
    sc.pp.highly_variable_genes(a, flavor='seurat')
    hv = a.var['highly_variable']
    print(a.var[['highly_variable']].head())
    print('value counts')
    print(hv.astype(str).value_counts(dropna=False))
    accepted={'True','1','TRUE'}
    hvg=set(a.var_names[hv.astype(str).isin(accepted)])
    print('HVG count',len(hvg), 'first', list(hvg)[:10])
    adata[i]=a
    if i==0: h1=hvg
    else: h2=hvg

inter=len(h1 & h2); union=len(h1 | h2)
print('h1',len(h1),'h2',len(h2),'inter',inter,'union',union)
if union==0:
    jac=np.nan
else:
    jac=inter/union
print('jac',jac)
print('ROUNDED', f'{jac:.2f}' if np.isfinite(jac) else 'NaN')
